calls.title: Growthbook <> First Table - Intro
calls.summary: Jay Jana (Head of Experimentation at First Table) discussed the need for mobile A/B testing on iOS and Android, as their current tool (Convert.com) only supports web, while 40% of their traffic comes from mobile apps. Daniel Wathne and Logan Bates (GrowthBook) presented their open-source platform

calls.title: GrowthBook<>First Table - Working Session
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Jake Heier, account manager; Logan Bates, solutions engineer) demoed their A/B testing platform to First Table (Jay Jana, PM; Jarryd Walker, developer; Devesh, mobile engineer), focusing on mobile SDK support for React Native to replace Convert.com’s lack of mobile testing. Key features discussed included Bayesian/Frequentist engines, guardrail metrics, holdouts, power calculators, templates, and Ampl

calls.title: Growthbook <> First Table - Data Warehouse Sync
calls.summary: First Table is focused on developing a unified data strategy to enhance its analytics capabilities and tackle fragmented data issues. Samuel Yap-Choong, who joined as the lead for this initiative, is guiding the team to create a data warehouse as a central pillar for data unification. The plan includes hiring a data engineer, a data scientist, and future graduates to bolster data product insights. Growth Book is being adopted to improve experimentation through a direct connection to the warehouse. The company is also leveraging AWS infrastructure to support scalable data operations. Emphasis is placed on cross-team collaboration to ensure clear roles, effective communication, and rapid iteration in optimizing data usage for decision-making.
calls.keywords: Data Warehouse, GrowthBook, Experimentation Platform, AWS, Data Integration, CRO
